reason: The arithmetic holds. The claimed local gain is not only possible, it was measured, and the counts reproduce it. (1) Per-edge check: score = adj edge J + 0.1 div J, and the stitch adds no nodes (dnodes = 0 in all 135 confirmation videos), so the node multiplier is untouched. An added evaluable TP converts an FN, so the denominator is unchanged and dJ = +1/D. An added FP gives dJ ~ -J/D. The per-edge net is therefore p(1+J) - J, and break-even is J/(1+J) = 0.48. Confirmation ef_st_all vs ef: 44b6 +27 TP / +3 FP on 19,826 GT edges, giving (27 - 2.8)/~20.5k = +0.00118, which equals the GT-weighted replay delta (+0.00118). 6bba +141 TP / +6 FP on 53,228 GT edges gives +0.0025 (replay +0.00251). Overall +0.00211 (divisions unchanged, 16/28/71). (2) Ceiling: the break class on the ef graph is 399 FN with oracle +0.0030 on 199 videos. st_all takes 281 TP / 19 FP = +0.0020, which is 67% of the class oracle. The other 118 breaks have no ILP edge, and non-ILP end->start pairs are 8-17% precise, far below the 0.48 break-even, so they are out of reach. The line is therefore capped at about +0.002 local, and it is <= 10% of the 0.022 gap to 0.97. (3) The gain exists mostly because of the edge filter: breaks go 150 -> 399 under ef. Without ef the stitch is worth +0.0007-0.0008, so its value depends on probe 29. PROBLEMS in the hypothesis as written; these are repairs, not refutations of the mechanism. (a) Its shipping form st_p07 fails the existing 44b6 mean gate (+0.00078 < +0.001). The p<0.7 slice is still net positive (41 TP / 11 FP, precision 0.79, net ~+0.0002). (b) Its placement 'before the short-track filter and linefit' is not what was measured and would change node counts. The measured call runs after linefit and ef, before divinsert. (c) The 44b6 evidence is thin. Its gain rests on 27 TP edges in 5 non-tied leak groups (5 wins / 0 losses, one-sided p = 0.031, not 0.003), and one group gives 49% of it. Counted at leak-group level, the 44b6 mean is +0.00097, just BELOW the +0.001 per-embryo gate. The per-video mean is +0.00106. So even st_all passes the embryo gate only by the counting convention. (d) Division interaction is small in expectation but large per event. With exp48 insertion on confirmation (div ~20/39/67), one division TP is worth ~0.0008, i.e. 40% of the stitch gain. The stitch can take a true orphan daughter only through an FP edge on a GT daughter (<= 9 evaluable FP on confirmation) or by exposing a p<0.3 stitched edge to steal. Expected cost is < 0.0001, but the swing is one event. A stitched true-parent edge can also create a new single-child parent candidate for insertion, so the sign is ambiguous.
fix_if_any: Ship only the refined form: st_all (STITCH_ENABLE=1, min_prob 0), placed after linefit and ef and before divinsert. Use it only inside the ef bundle, and only if probe 29 shows ef transfers. If ef fails, drop the stitch, because +0.0007 is below every gate and below LB resolution. Declare the tie-aware gate as a post-hoc amendment for add-only rules. Report 44b6 both per video and per leak group, and state that the group-level mean (+0.00097) is borderline. Do not pick st_all over st_p07 because of the 44b6 mean: that choice rests on ~10 edges. Pick it because the p<0.7 slice has a positive net at precision 0.79 (net per edge 0.59 vs 0.88), a margin of about 1.6x break-even. In the e48 lab run, report division TP/FP with and without the stitch, plus divins_added_orphan and divins_missing_p. Accept only if the division change is at most 1 TP event (<= 0.0008) and the edge gain is >= +0.0015.
realistic_public_gain: Conditional on probe 29 transferring: about +0.0005 to +0.0015 public/private (best guess +0.001). The embryo-level gain in the lab is 0.12-0.25 points, scaled by the out-of-sample precision factor p(1+J)-J over 0.878: 0.70 at p = 0.8, 0.48 at p = 0.7, 0.26 at p = 0.6. The ILP p tracks annotated cells in 6bba, a leakage signature, so the low-p slice probably loses precision out of sample. If ef does not transfer: about +0.0003 (local +0.0007 x ~0.5), which is invisible. Unconditional expected value is about +0.0007. It cannot be resolved at 3-decimal LB precision alone, so it goes only in the ef bundle, and it does not move the 0.97 target materially (<= 0.002 of the 0.022 gap).
